title: Why do we yawn?
examples: Teacher, does yawning mean I am sleepy?
Why do I yawn when I see someone else yawn?
Is yawning good or bad for my body?

explain.say: A yawn is when your mouth opens wide.
Sometimes yawning happens when you feel very tired.
One idea is that yawning helps cool your brain.

draw.text: Cooling the brain with a yawn

explain.say: It can also seem like yawning spreads to others.
In real life, you might yawn when reading a very long book.

draw.text: Reading long books can make you yawn

explain.say: A common mistake is thinking yawning only happens when you are sleepy.

items: It can be about focusing your mind.

draw.text: Yawning has more reasons than sleep

faq.q: Does yawning mean I need to sleep right now?
faq.a: Not always. While tiredness can cause it, yawning can also be your body trying to cool down.
asks: Is yawning a sign of sleepiness?
If I yawn, must I take a nap?

faq.q: Why do I yawn when I see my friend yawn?
faq.a: This is called contagious yawning. It is linked to how we connect with other people.
asks: Why does yawning spread between people?

faq.q: Is yawning good for my brain?
faq.a: Scientists think it helps regulate your body temperature, which is good for your brain.

faq.q: Does yawning mean I am bored?
faq.a: Sometimes it can be related to boredom, but it is not the only reason your body might yawn.
asks: Can I yawn if I am not bored?

faq.q: Does yawning mean I am sick?
faq.a: No, yawning itself does not mean you are sick. It is usually a normal body action.
asks: Can yawning mean I have a cold?

facts: Yawning is a natural action that involves opening the mouth wide.
One theory suggests yawning helps to cool the brain.
Yawning can spread from person to person, which is normal.
It is not always a direct sign of needing sleep.

quiz.say: If your brain feels too warm, what might yawning help to do?

options.show: It means you are very happy.
options.say: It means you are very happy.

options.show: It helps to cool the brain down.
options.say: It helps to cool the brain down.

options.show: It means you need to eat a snack.
options.say: It means you need to eat a snack.

quiz.why: The lesson said that one idea is that yawning helps cool your brain.

wrong.0: This is tempting because big feelings can change our body.
wrong.2: This is tempting because we link yawning to needing energy.
wrong.3: This is tempting because boredom can make us feel tired.

quiz.say: When you see your friend yawn, what is this called?

options.show: It is a signal of sickness.
options.say: It is a signal of sickness.

options.show: It is a sign of deep sleep.
options.say: It is a sign of deep sleep.

options.show: It is a sign of excitement.
options.say: It is a sign of excitement.

quiz.why: The lesson showed that yawning can spread from person to person.

wrong.0: This is tempting because we worry when our bodies act strangely.
wrong.1: This is tempting because sleepiness often comes with yawning.
wrong.2: This is tempting because strong emotions can affect us.

quiz.say: If you are reading something very interesting, are you likely to yawn?

options.show: No, you are less likely to yawn.
options.say: No, you are less likely to yawn.

options.show: Yes, because you are thinking hard.
options.say: Yes, because you are thinking hard.

quiz.why: Yawning is more linked to tiredness or temperature, not necessarily interest.

wrong.0: This is tempting because quiet times can feel sleepy.
wrong.2: This is tempting because long things can make us feel bored.
wrong.3: This is tempting because thinking uses up a lot of energy.
